_comment: /deploy-global merges this block into ~/.claude/settings.json idempotently (additive upsert by command — see deploy-global step 13). PreToolUse on the subagent tool (`Agent` today; `Task` is the former name, kept so an older build still matches) AND on the file-edit tools (Claude Write/Edit/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit, Grok search_replace/write_file/create_file/edit_file). The script gates on a flow-workspace ledger (`_support/PROJECT.md` above cwd) AND either an executor subagent (roster whose `tools:` carries Write/Edit) or an inline edit of PROJECT CODE (under the workspace root; never .md/.txt or other doc formats, never `_support/`, `*-specs/`, `docs/` or harness config dirs — the ledger, plans, task records and memory stay silent so the gate cannot loop on the files that record the decision); with no plan holding implementation authority (plan.py inspect → can_implement) it emits an ADVISORY via additionalContext once per session and plan-state signature — or a DENY (exit 2 + decision JSON) when the ledger declares `| Executor dispatch | plan-required |`. Any internal error exits 0 silently. Policy: CLAUDE.md > Communication (mid-discussion agreement is not implementation authorization), flow-plan's approval contract.
